create_model_run_factory: create a Django factory for ModelRun with minimal defaults and auto-generated project, organization, and created_by fields
test_model_run_factory: test the ModelRunFactory to generate ModelRun instances with PENDING status and zero prediction counts
build_model_run_completed: build a completed ModelRun instance using ModelRunFactory with auto-set triggered_at and completed_at timestamps
refactor_model_run_factory: refactor the ModelRunFactory to support custom project subsets and model versions in test fixtures
review_model_run_factory: review the ModelRunFactory and its _default_timestamps post-generation hook for timestamp handling on completed runs
